import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorders = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorders.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorders == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
top_occupations = occupation_sleep.head(8)
ax2.barh(range(len(top_occupations)), top_occupations.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(top_occupations)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(top_occupations.index, fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation\n(Bottom 8)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=40)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)

# 5. Heart Rate by Age Group and Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 60], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
age_gender_hr = df.groupby(['Age Group', 'Gender'])['Heart Rate'].mean().unstack()
age_gender_hr.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate by Age Group & Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily Steps Distribution with Sleep Disorder
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
sleep_disorders_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorders_list = sleep_disorders_clean.unique()
data_to_plot = [df[sleep_disorders_clean == disorder]['Daily Steps'].dropna() for disorder in disorders_list]
violin = ax6.violinplot(data_to_plot, positions=range(len(disorders_list)), 
                        showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(disorders_list)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(disorders_list, fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Correlation Heatmap
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            ax=ax7, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'fontsize': 7})
ax7.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xticklabels(ax7.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax7.set_yticklabels(ax7.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
